speech.p: I propose a public register for regional transport projects. Residents should be able to inspect the budget, the delivery timetable and the reasons for selecting each route. An independent review will test whether the work meets those published commitments.

I ask whether the proposed register will include the accessibility of stations. Community groups have requested clear information about ramps, lifts and connecting bus services. Their submissions should be published alongside the project assessment and the government's response.
The review should publish its findings every year.

Order. Members should direct their comments through the chair and return to the question before the chamber. The discussion must follow the standing orders, and the remaining speaking time will be allocated in accordance with the agreement already reached by the chamber.
The committee will review this matter and report its findings after hearing the community submissions.
